title: How to organise the linen and towel storage | Primary Bathroom
description:
To hold enough clean towels for the way this house actually does laundry, and no more than the shelf can safely carry.

This is the Linen and Towel Storage in the Primary Bathroom. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Three bath towels per person, one in use, one in the wash, one folded on the shelf. Each guest set nested in its own pillowcase, hand towels and washcloths in separate labeled columns, and a spare bath mat rolled at the end of the shelf.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Take every towel out and rank them by which one your hand actually goes to after a shower.
Straighten: Fold everything to one width so the stack squares up, then keep bath towels, hand towels, and washcloths in th
Shine: Wipe the shelves and press the back wall for damp, because a towel put away not quite dry will scent the whole
Safety: A deep stack of linens on a shelf held by four small brackets is a load nobody ever weighed.
Standardize: The count is the standard: three bath towels per person, folded to one width, one label per column.
Sustain: When you fold laundry, clean towels go to the bottom of their column so the oldest keeps coming to your hand,

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Three bath towels per person, folded to one width, columns labeled by type, and nothing put away damp.
